Nonzero unresolved-review queues are surfaced but do not fail data quality.
Mutually exclusive review domains must reconcile to the total open review population.
Every field conflict is grouped once by its actual field_name.
All active review schemas retain source or compared-entity identifiers; sampled evidence completeness is tested in regression tests.
Only a closed review provably created or resolved at/after the persisted versioned-audit boundary fails; undated or older legacy gaps are separately reported as HISTORICAL_REVIEW_AUDIT_INCOMPLETE.
Legacy closed reviews without versioned audit metadata remain visible for historical reconciliation; no actor or resolution timestamp is inferred.
Only human decision actions are checked against the current enum; system cleanup and lifecycle supersession transitions are excluded.
A population drop outside the recent comparable dataset history must block lifecycle removals.
Removal counters must equal persisted new lifecycle transitions; audited historical discrepancies are traceable.
Latest failed/incomplete Furas attempt is not a coverage assertion; retry may be in flight.
Technical health and coverage_status are distinct persisted fields and API values.
Status, job_state, and finished_at must agree with the recorded lifecycle.
A Furas checkpoint must preserve its initial membership, committed cursor, and terminal job outcome. Explicitly rejected legacy failures are historical, non-resumable evidence.
Source-specific stale thresholds use three times p95 and twice the observed maximum after at least eight successful runs, with hard-limit and sparse-history floors.
A retrying job without a recent attempt beyond its source-specific stale threshold requires reconciliation.
Source-specific reservation and lock controls permit at most one running job per source.
A DB RUNNING job must map to a live Celery task or source lock; broker/Redis inspection failures are warnings.
A source lock without a live source task or queued/running job is orphaned.
Enabled sources with an implemented adapter are covered by the one-minute due-source dispatcher.
A recurring source window is missed only when its interval plus two dispatcher ticks elapsed without a job, active job, Redis lock/reservation, or global pause.
Source-aware freshness uses complete scan or explicitly successful public-scope verification, with separate warning and critical limits.
